fichas.title: Rabbit Hutches and Cages
fichas.summary: Guidance and illustrated examples for rabbit hutches, stacked hutches, wire cages, and breeding cages. Hutches should be ventilated, dry, protected from sun and predators, easy to clean, and equipped with urine drainage. The page gives hutch area per animal, hutch size by rabbit type, stacking guidance, cage mesh dimensions, nesting-box clearance, and climate requirements for breeding and fattening.
uses: Protecting animals from predators and poor climate

fichas.title: Goat Housing and Feeding
fichas.summary: Illustrated goat-shed and goat-pen arrangements include tethered stalls, loose housing, deep-litter beds, slatted floors, feeding stands, racks, troughs, and rest alcoves. The guidance addresses orientation, ventilation, lighting, stall and feeding dimensions, animal space requirements, and selected building provisions.
